title: recover-Q: (6,2) STNFS, twisted C4 base field, run gate: expected 2^114.128838

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, uniform challenges and fresh coins, proof.md's algorithm returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 at expected total work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^115.485920+2^66) < 2^114.128838 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions); every run below 2^124.003859000001 units. The coin is part of the one cold attack on the one target: the run reads one fresh 64-bit coin before any other work, then stops at the charged closed-gate cost (a failure) or, with probability K/2^64, performs the whole attack; K=7201071206392798289 is least with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39, lo_run=0.99905 the opened run's success bound under H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT. The work is that one run's expected total work; nothing is amortized over other targets or runs. The expected opened-run bound charges all non-descent ledger rows in full and the descent at its H5 first-moment bound 2^109.900; the capped work is no larger. Peak storage below 2^106 bytes, no nonuniform advice; all preprocessing is included. Boot trials use fresh exponent and ball cell per trial with 2^38 expected setup instructions charged; see DESCENT.md. The total-work meter includes setup. Block dimensions are (8192,325); GENERATOR.md supplies the PM-Basis algorithm and instruction envelope under the retained H-FFT and H-X hypotheses at these parameters. RHS.md defines the B=alpha[M|0],Y=[alpha S|V],alpha=2^-320 mod r recovery for both Schirokauer cases; main-phase exceptional-draw allowance is2^-66 under its two explicit truncated-Krylov-minor H-X conditions. N_MAX=3*2^25 is charged with new abort/repeat bounds. Horner dots are reduced in groups of at most16 products; explicit extra2^74 setup/transfer units and the charged per-coordinate dot overhead are included.
